subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Automation Strategy Roadmap
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Automation Strategy Roadmap.

hook.text: A new QA lead inherits zero automation and a mandate to automate everything in six months.

buildup.text: Automating everything at once leads to burnout and a fragile, half-finished suite.

discovery.text: A phased roadmap starts with smoke tests, then regression, then edge cases over time.

twist.text: The roadmap must include milestones for team training, not just coverage goals.

climax.text: Six months later, critical paths are automated and the team is ready to expand further.

punchline.text: Start small. Prove value. Scale with confidence.

quiz.question: How should an automation roadmap start?
options: With high-value smoke and regression tests first
